issues: Modal backdrop appears highly translucent — the underlying result card (CALL hero, confidence tile, key levels) is clearly visible behind the modal content, causing visual overlap/readability concern on mobile. Modal itself is functional and all content fits without scroll, but a more opaque backdrop or stronger blur would improve readability. Non-blocking, cosmetic.
